assertions.name: decode-corpus
assertions.evidence: The headline is quoted correctly: "LAUNCHING in the LAUNCH ZONE only." It matches `rules.py lookup G416 --season decode-2025-26` short_title. But the run never used the DECODE corpus. scripts_run contains only pdftotext, grep and sed on a downloaded manual PDF (webfetch-...pdf -> manual.txt). There is no rules.py call with --season decode-2025-26, and files_read has no corpus file. The assertion requires use of the DECODE corpus, and a web-fetched PDF is not that, so it fails.

assertions.name: season-labeled
assertions.evidence: The answer opens with "G416 in DECODE (2025-2026) was the rule that you could only launch from inside a launch zone." It uses past tense throughout ("cost you more", "that was a G416 foul") and never presents the rule as current. It does not mention that BIOBUZZ G416 is a different rule (construction limits), but this assertion does not require that.
